sentences.text: I noticed a cold spot in the living room, where the temperature was 16.9 °C at 05:20, which was below the expected 18.0 °C.
The living room stayed below 18.0 °C from 02:10 to 06:00, and the WHO recommends at least 18 °C indoors in cold seasons.
The bathroom also stayed below 18.0 °C, with the coldest reading being 17.8 °C.
Since both rooms were below 18.0 °C, I suggest checking the heating to help keep things warm.
